base_eval.vsl_text:
STATES: S_IDLE=0, S_1=1, S_11=2, S_110=3, S_SHIFT0=4, S_SHIFT1=5, S_SHIFT2=6, S_SHIFT3=7, S_COUNT=8, S_DONE=9

REG state[4] @clk.pos reset.sync->0 NEXT=next_state
COMB next_state
  state=S_IDLE & data=1 -> S_1
| state=S_IDLE & data=0 -> S_IDLE
| state=S_1 & data=1 -> S_11
| state=S_1 & data=0 -> S_IDLE
| state=S_11 & data=0 -> S_110
| state=S_11 & data=1 -> S_11
| state=S_110 & data=1 -> S_SHIFT0
| state=S_110 & data=0 -> S_IDLE
| state=S_SHIFT0 -> S_SHIFT1
| state=S_SHIFT1 -> S_SHIFT2
| state=S_SHIFT2 -> S_SHIFT3
| state=S_SHIFT3 -> S_COUNT
| state=S_COUNT & cycle_cnt=999 & delay=0 -> S_DONE
| state=S_COUNT -> S_COUNT
| state=S_DONE & ack=1 -> S_IDLE
| state=S_DONE & ack=0 -> S_DONE
| * -> S_IDLE

REG delay[4] @clk.pos reset.sync->0
  state=S_SHIFT0 -> {delay[2:0], data}
| state=S_SHIFT1 -> {delay[2:0], data}
| state=S_SHIFT2 -> {delay[2:0], data}
| state=S_SHIFT3 -> {delay[2:0], data}
| state=S_COUNT & cycle_cnt=999 & delay!=0 -> delay-1
| * -> delay

REG cycle_cnt[10] @clk.pos reset.sync->0
  state=S_COUNT & cycle_cnt=999 -> 0
| state=S_COUNT -> cycle_cnt+1
| * -> 0

REG counting @clk.pos reset.sync->0 PORT
  state=S_SHIFT3 -> 1
| state=S_COUNT & cycle_cnt=999 & delay=0 -> 0
| * -> counting

REG done @clk.pos reset.sync->0 PORT
  state=S_COUNT & cycle_cnt=999 & delay=0 -> 1
| state=S_DONE & ack=1 -> 0
| * -> done

count = delay
